title: Tavern lean: find a safe way to get a played pawn out of a lean (DPC 0.9.176-dev2)
intro: tavern-lean-4 showed it: the freeze comes from DPC force-ending the pawn's lean (the AI decision). With that off, the pawn just stays stuck in the lean. This run keeps it off and tries three gentler ways out, one per step. Any of them could still freeze the game, so SAVE FIRST. Tavern; the test puts you on the Arisen. Press End.

steps.text: 1/7 Get ready: saved, in a tavern, playing the Arisen. Press End.

2/7 Stand still near a wall until your main pawn leans on it (or sits, or poses). It can take a minute or two; the pawn row on screen shows what each pawn is doing. End once he's posing (don't take control yet).
3/7 Take control of your main pawn while he leans (the AI interrupt is off, so he'll probably be stuck). Try to move. End.
4/7 Try 1: DPC now asks the game to put him back into normal walking. Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
5/7 Try 2: DPC now asks the game to make him idle. Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
6/7 Try 3: DPC now asks the game to end his AI decision the normal way (not forced). Try to move. Note whether he's free. If the game freezes, close it, restart and tell Claude which try. End.
7/7 Back to the Arisen. Tell Claude which try freed him, if any. End.
